info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Zeolite Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Zeolite Battery Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed catalogs for zeolite batteries. This endpoint allows users to submit comprehensive product details, such as specifications, pricing, and availability. Ideal for manufacturers, retailers, and developers looking to maintain an accurate product catalog, this API streamlines the addition of new battery products to inventories. Businesses can leverage this API to enhance their offerings and ensure customers have access to up-to-date information on zeolite batteries.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create new details related to zeolite batteries. It captures all necessary information required to thoroughly represent the specifics of the zeolite battery in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send the details needed to create or update a zeolite battery record. It should include all required properties outlined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogZeoliteBatteryDetailRequest.title: Zeolite Battery Order Request

zeolite_battery_id.description: The unique identifier for the zeolite battery being ordered.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the order.

quantity.description: The quantity of zeolite batteries requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether this order should be prioritized.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the zeolite battery.

supplier.description: Information about the supplier providing the zeolite battery.

CreateCatalogZeoliteBatteryDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for placing an order for zeolite batteries.

Supplier.title: Supplier Information

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been verified.

Supplier.description: Schema representing details about the supplier of the zeolite battery.

ContactInformation.title: Contact Information

email.description: The email address for contacting the supplier.

phone.description: The phone number for contacting the supplier.

ContactInformation.description: Schema representing the contact details for the supplier.

CreateCatalogZeoliteBatteryDetailRespons.title: Zeolite Battery Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: A unique identifier for the record created or updated during the operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The count of records that matched the operation criteria.

CreateCatalogZeoliteBatteryDetailRespons.description: Schema representing the response for Zeolite Battery operation POST requests.

content-type.description: The Content-Type header indicates the media type of the resource being sent to the client. It specifies the format of the data being returned in the response.

x-processing-time.description: The X-Processing-Time header provides the duration, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can be useful for performance monitoring.
